claims.claim: Microsoft Xbox One S All-Digital Edition Console (Disc-free ...)
claims.evidence: Photos show an Xbox One S-looking console with Xbox logo, but do not show a clear view of the disc drive bay or the model/label that confirms 'All-Digital Edition'.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: The unit is wrapped in plastic, but wrapping alone does not prove it was never opened/repaired; no tamper seals/serial verification shown.
No temperature/usage history or test footage; photos cannot confirm overheating.
No close-up of ports and no functional test shown.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt
claims.evidence: No clear photo of the 'pads' (accessories) or the UK receipt text.

risks.risk: Not actually the All-Digital (could be a standard One S with disc drive, or a different Xbox model/variant).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console model/serial label (underside/back) and a close-up showing whether there is a disc drive slot/bay.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a standard Xbox One S (not confirmed all-digital) and/or as not confirmed variant; treat as worst-case for buyer value until label/disc-bay is verified.

risks.risk: Console may not power on / may have faults (HDMI, power supply, overheating, controller pairing issues).
risks.proof: Short video clip of power-on to the dashboard, plus a quick HDMI output check and controller pairing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working (or untested) until a power-on functional video is provided.

risks.risk: Ports may be damaged (HDMI, USB, power port) even if the unit looks intact.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all ports and a test video plugging in at least one USB device and showing HDMI display.
risks.if_unproven: Price as ports not guaranteed; assume at least one port could be faulty until tested.

risks.risk: Accessories/packaging not complete (missing cables, controller, original pads).
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (console + all accessories) with a checklist, and a clear photo of the receipt.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console only (no accessories/receipt) until completeness is shown.

risks.risk: Potential scam/low-quality listing (photos may not match the exact unit; serial not verified).
risks.proof: Photo of the console with a handwritten Lagos date + the last 4 digits of the serial/label visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest buyer-risk level (as unverified/possibly mismatched) until serial/date proof is provided.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the console model/serial label (underside/back) showing it is Xbox One S All-Digital Edition.
Video clip: power on to dashboard (or setup screen) showing HDMI output working.
Video clip: quick test of USB port(s) and controller pairing.
Photos of all included items laid out (console + cables + controller + any 'pads') and a readable UK receipt.
response.reason: The photos show an Xbox One S-looking console, but they do not confirm the 'All-Digital' variant, nor do they prove it powers on and that ports work. Missing functional and identity proof prevents a confident price.
